title: Oh No No No
blurb: Wheezing, escalating laughter that arrives before the impact does, which is the whole art form. TikTok attaches this to disasters already in progress: the skateboard leaving the rail, the wedding cake beginning to lean, the plan visibly disassembling in real time. The comic timing is inverted from normal — you are laughing at the outcome several seconds before it happens, because everybody can see where this is going except the person in the video. A fail-video institution, and the closest thing the genre has to a laugh track.
origin: The viral laughing track played over slow-motion disasters on TikTok.
